triggers: Lakshmi taps Share this checklist with family
side_effects: A plain text summary is generated from the saved checklist and its schemes and passed to the device share sheet
No Profile fields are read or included in the summary text
error_handling: If a scheme on the checklist has no deadline, the summary shows 'Deadline to be confirmed' for that scheme instead of omitting it
If a scheme has no required documents listed, the summary shows 'Document list being updated' for that scheme

business_rules.name: share_summary_uses_non_guaranteed_language
business_rules.description: The shared summary uses only the labels 'Likely eligible' or 'May qualify' and never uses words such as 'approved' or 'guaranteed'.
triggers: Lakshmi taps Share this checklist with family
side_effects: The summary text carries the same eligibility wording shown on the results screen
The summary includes the disclaimer 'HaqPath provides guidance based on published rules. Final eligibility is decided by the relevant authority.'
error_handling: If a scheme's eligibility label cannot be determined, the summary uses 'May qualify' rather than a stronger label

business_rules.name: share_summary_includes_official_source_and_verification_date
business_rules.description: Each scheme in the shared summary includes its official source link and the date it was last verified.
triggers: Lakshmi taps Share this checklist with family
side_effects: Each scheme block in the summary text shows 'Official source' with its URL and 'Last verified on [date]'
error_handling: If a scheme has no official_url, the share is blocked for that checklist and the user sees 'Official source missing for [scheme name]'

business_rules.name: share_only_covers_schemes_on_the_checklist
business_rules.description: The shared summary lists only the schemes that belong to the saved checklist, in the order they were added.
triggers: Lakshmi taps Share this checklist with family
side_effects: The summary includes each scheme's current progress status from the checklist (Not started, Documents ready, Applied, or Awaiting outcome)
error_handling: If the checklist has no schemes, the share button is disabled and the message 'Add a scheme to your checklist before sharing' is shown

business_rules.name: share_summary_marks_passed_deadlines
business_rules.description: A scheme whose deadline has already passed on the day of sharing is marked 'Deadline passed' in the summary.
triggers: Lakshmi taps Share this checklist with family
side_effects: The summary text shows 'Deadline passed' next to that scheme name instead of a date
error_handling: If the device date is unavailable, the deadline is shown as a plain date without a passed marker

name: Deadline Countdown and Progress Tracking
description: A student tracks each saved scheme's deadline countdown and moves it through Not started, Documents ready, Applied, and Awaiting outcome.

steps.description: The student opens the tracker and sees a countdown for each saved scheme's deadline.

business_rules.name: countdown_shows_days_left_until_scheme_deadline
business_rules.description: For each saved scheme, the tracker shows the number of days left until Scheme.deadline, calculated from today's date when the page loads.
triggers: Student opens the deadline and progress tracker page
Student returns to the tracker after the day changes
side_effects: Each saved scheme card shows a countdown such as '12 days left' or 'Closes today'
No stored data is changed; the countdown is calculated for display only
error_handling: If Scheme.deadline is missing, the card shows 'Deadline not yet published' and the scheme is not sorted by urgency
If Scheme.deadline has passed, the card shows 'Deadline has passed' and the application-steps action is marked as closed, not removed
If the scheme record cannot be loaded, the card shows 'We could not load this deadline. Try again' with a retry action, and the other cards still display

business_rules.name: tracker_lists_only_schemes_saved_to_checklist
business_rules.description: The tracker shows a countdown only for schemes that have a saved Checklist for this student, and each Checklist links to exactly one Scheme.
triggers: Student opens the deadline and progress tracker page
Student saves a scheme to their checklist from the results or scheme detail screen
side_effects: Saved schemes appear as cards on the tracker, each with its countdown
Schemes that were never saved do not appear on the tracker, even if they matched the student's profile
error_handling: If the student has no saved checklists, the page shows an empty state that explains how to save a scheme from results, with a button back to results
If a Checklist points to a Scheme that no longer exists in the catalogue, that card is hidden and the record is flagged for review instead of showing a broken countdown

business_rules.name: countdown_urgency_order_by_nearest_deadline
business_rules.description: Saved schemes are ordered by days remaining to Scheme.deadline, soonest first, and deadlines within 7 days are marked as urgent.
triggers: Student opens the deadline and progress tracker page
A deadline moves into the 7-day window while the student is viewing the tracker
side_effects: The scheme with the nearest deadline appears first on the tracker
Schemes with 7 or fewer days left show an 'Urgent' label on their card
error_handling: Schemes with no published deadline are placed at the bottom of the list, after all dated schemes
Schemes with the same deadline date are ordered by Scheme.name so the list order stays stable

business_rules.name: countdown_shows_last_verified_date_with_deadline
business_rules.description: Each countdown displays the Scheme.last_verified_at date next to the deadline so students can see how current the deadline information is.
triggers: Student views any saved scheme card on the tracker
side_effects: Each card shows 'Deadline last verified on [date]' with a link to Scheme.official_url for checking the official notice
If Scheme.last_verified_at is more than 30 days old, the card shows 'Please check the official notice, as this may have changed'
error_handling: If Scheme.last_verified_at is missing, the card shows 'Verification date not recorded' and still displays the official link
The countdown is never shown without a verification date and official source, since the deadline must be traceable

steps.description: The student taps a scheme and updates its status from Not started to Documents ready, then Applied, then Awaiting outcome.

business_rules.name: progress_status_follows_fixed_sequence
business_rules.description: A scheme's checklist status moves through Not started → Documents ready → Applied → Awaiting outcome, in that order, and the student can advance only to the next state in the sequence.
triggers: Student taps a scheme's status control and selects the next state
Student taps the status control on a saved scheme in the progress tracker
side_effects: Checklist.status changes to the selected state
The progress tracker and the shareable checklist summary show the new state
error_handling: If the student selects a state that skips a step (for example Not started directly to Applied), the change is refused and the control shows the next available state
If the checklist is missing for the scheme, the status control is hidden and the student is asked to save the scheme first

business_rules.name: student_may_correct_status_one_step_back
business_rules.description: A student may move a scheme's checklist status back by one state to correct an accidental tap, such as Applied back to Documents ready.
triggers: Student taps a back or undo option on the status control after an accidental advance
side_effects: Checklist.status changes to the previous state
The progress tracker shows the corrected state
error_handling: If the student attempts to move back from Not started, the option is not shown because there is no earlier state
If the student attempts to move back more than one state at once, the change is refused and only one-step correction is offered

business_rules.name: status_change_records_self_reported_progress_only
business_rules.description: Every status change is a student's self-reported progress and does not confirm any submission, approval, or outcome with the government authority.
triggers: Student selects Applied or Awaiting outcome for a scheme
side_effects: Checklist.status_updated_at is set to the time of the change
The status label reads as the student's own progress, not as a government decision
error_handling: If a status label would imply approval (for example the word approved or selected), it is not shown; only the four defined progress labels appear

business_rules.name: status_does_not_alter_eligibility_result
business_rules.description: Changing a checklist status does not recalculate or change any EligibilityResult or the Profile, because progress and eligibility are separate concerns.
triggers: Student updates the status of any saved scheme
side_effects: EligibilityResult for the scheme keeps its existing category and explanation
Profile values are left unchanged
error_handling: If a status update would require eligibility recalculation, the update still saves and the eligibility result is left as previously computed

business_rules.name: status_updates_limited_to_saved_checklist
business_rules.description: Only schemes that the student has saved to their personalised checklist can have a progress status, so each Checklist record links to exactly one Scheme.
triggers: Student opens a scheme's progress status control from the results or scheme detail screen
side_effects: The status control is shown on the scheme only when a Checklist exists for it
Tracker lists only schemes that have a Checklist
error_handling: If the scheme is not saved, the status control shows Save to checklist first and no status change is written
If the Scheme no longer exists in the catalogue, the Checklist is shown as retired and its status is kept read-only

validation_rules.description: A progress status must be selected before the change is saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a status for this scheme.

validation_rules.description: The status must be one of the four defined values: Not started, Documents ready, Applied, or Awaiting outcome.
validation_rules.error_message: This status is not available. Please choose one of the listed steps.

steps.description: The tracker saves the updated status and shows the progress summary across all saved schemes.

business_rules.name: checklist_status_uses_four_fixed_stages
business_rules.description: Each saved scheme checklist holds exactly one status, moving through the stages not_started → documents_ready → applied → awaiting_outcome.
triggers: User selects a new status for a saved scheme in the tracker
User opens a saved scheme checklist for the first time
side_effects: Checklist.status is set to the chosen stage
Checklist.updated_at is set to the time of the change
The new stage is written to Upstash so it persists across visits
error_handling: If the submitted status is not one of the four stages, the change is rejected and the previous status is kept
A new checklist for a saved scheme starts at not_started if no status has been chosen

business_rules.name: status_change_is_allowed_in_either_direction
business_rules.description: A family may move a checklist forward or back between stages, since mistakes and changed circumstances are common.
triggers: User changes status to an earlier stage, such as moving from applied back to documents_ready
side_effects: Checklist.status is updated to the earlier stage
The progress summary recounts the scheme under its new stage
error_handling: If the save to Upstash fails, the status reverts to its last saved value and the user is told the change was not saved

business_rules.name: progress_summary_counts_saved_schemes_only
business_rules.description: The progress summary counts only the checklists the profile has saved, grouped by their current stage, and ignores schemes that were never saved.
triggers: User opens the deadline and progress tracker
A checklist status is saved and the summary refreshes
side_effects: The summary shows the number of saved schemes at each stage
The summary shows an overall completion measure based on schemes that have reached awaiting_outcome or applied
error_handling: If the profile has no saved checklists, the summary shows an empty state that invites the user to save a scheme from results
If one checklist cannot be read from Upstash, the summary shows the others and marks that scheme as unavailable instead of showing a wrong count

business_rules.name: passed_deadline_flags_unfinished_checklist
business_rules.description: A saved checklist whose Scheme.deadline has passed and whose status is still not_started or documents_ready is flagged as past deadline in the summary, without changing its status.
triggers: Progress summary is rendered
Current date passes a saved scheme's deadline
side_effects: The summary displays a past-deadline label next to that scheme
Checklist.status is not changed by this check
error_handling: If Scheme.deadline is missing, no deadline flag is shown and the scheme is listed with its stage only
A checklist already at applied or awaiting_outcome is never flagged as past deadline

business_rules.name: progress_saves_only_after_confirmed_write
business_rules.description: The tracker displays a new status as saved only after Upstash confirms the write, so the screen never shows progress that is not stored.
triggers: User selects a new status and the save request is sent to Upstash
side_effects: On confirmation, the new status appears in the tracker and in the progress summary
On failure, the previous status is shown again and a retry message is displayed
error_handling: If Upstash is unreachable, the user sees a message that progress could not be saved and can try again
Repeated taps on the same status while a save is pending send only one write

validation_rules.description: A status must be selected before a checklist progress change can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose where you are with this scheme.

validation_rules.description: The status must be one of not_started, documents_ready, applied, or awaiting_outcome.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose one of the four progress stages.

name: Regional Language, Voice Input, and Simple-Language Rewriting
description: A student switches to the regional language, speaks the situation instead of typing, and reads scheme explanations rewritten in very simple language.

steps.description: On the welcome screen the student switches to the regional language using a clear language toggle.

business_rules.name: language_switch_is_instant_and_bundled
business_rules.description: The student can switch the welcome screen between English and the regional language, and the new language is shown immediately using translations bundled with the app.
triggers: Student taps the language toggle on the welcome screen
Student taps the language toggle while a regional-language preference is already active
side_effects: All welcome screen text, labels, and the trust statement switch to the selected language
No network call is made to OpenAI for the switch, so the toggle still works if internet access fails
error_handling: If a translation string is missing for the selected language, the English text is shown for that string and the missing key is logged for the team
If the bundled language file fails to load, the welcome screen stays in English and the toggle shows a short notice to try again

business_rules.name: language_choice_does_not_change_eligibility_logic
business_rules.description: Switching language changes only the displayed text; it never changes which eligibility rules are evaluated or how results are classified.
triggers: Student switches the language on the welcome screen before or after entering a situation
Student switches the language on any later screen that shows results
side_effects: Eligibility results and their categories (likely, may qualify, not currently eligible) stay the same in both languages
The official source link and the 'Last verified' date are shown unchanged in the selected language
error_handling: If a translated scheme explanation is missing, the English plain-language explanation is shown with a note that the regional version is being prepared

business_rules.name: language_preference_is_device_local
business_rules.description: The chosen language is remembered only on the student's device for this visit and is not tied to any personal profile.
triggers: Student selects a language on the welcome screen
Student returns to the welcome screen during the same session
side_effects: The selected language is kept in the device's local session storage
No language preference is sent to the server or saved to any Profile record
error_handling: If local storage is unavailable, the language resets to English on the next visit and the toggle still works for the current session

validation_rules.description: The selected language must be either English or the supported regional language.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose English or the regional language.

steps.description: The student taps the microphone and speaks the situation in the regional language instead of typing.

business_rules.name: voice_input_is_optional_alternative_to_typing
business_rules.description: The student may speak their situation instead of typing it, and both inputs produce the same situation text for the Profile.
triggers: Student taps the microphone button on the 'Tell us about your situation' screen
Student chooses to type instead of speaking
side_effects: Profile.input_method is set to 'voice' or 'text' depending on how the situation was entered
Profile.situation_text is filled with the transcribed words, which the student can read and edit before continuing
error_handling: If the student switches to typing after speaking, the spoken transcript is replaced by the typed text and Profile.input_method is set to 'text'
If the student taps the microphone and then cancels, no text is saved and the typed field is left as it was

business_rules.name: speech_is_transcribed_in_selected_regional_language
business_rules.description: Speech is sent for transcription in the regional language the student selected on the welcome screen, falling back to English only when the student has chosen English.
triggers: Student finishes speaking and the recording is submitted for transcription
Student changes the language toggle before tapping the microphone
side_effects: OpenAI speech-to-text transcribes the audio using the language stored in Profile.input_language
Profile.situation_text is filled with the transcript in the spoken language, and the English translation is produced later by the language step
error_handling: If the selected language is not supported by the transcription service, the student sees a message that voice input is not yet available in that language and is offered typing
If the detected language differs from the selected one, the transcript is still shown and the student is asked to confirm the language before extraction

business_rules.name: transcript_is_reviewable_before_profile_extraction
business_rules.description: The transcript appears in an editable text field, and the student must confirm it before any profile details are extracted from it.
triggers: Transcription of the student's speech completes
Student taps 'Continue' after reviewing the transcript
side_effects: Profile.transcript_confirmed is set to true when the student taps continue
Profile details are extracted from the confirmed Profile.situation_text by the next step
error_handling: If the student edits the transcript, the edited text replaces the original and Profile.transcript_confirmed is reset to false until they confirm again
If the student leaves the transcript unconfirmed and closes the screen, the draft is kept only for the current session

business_rules.name: audio_is_never_stored
business_rules.description: Recorded audio is sent for transcription and discarded; only the text transcript is kept on the Profile.
triggers: Recording stops and the audio is submitted for transcription
Transcription succeeds or fails
side_effects: The audio is deleted from the device memory after transcription finishes
No voice recording is written to Upstash or any other storage
error_handling: If transcription fails, the audio is still discarded and the student is told to try again or type instead
If the student leaves the page during recording, the audio buffer is cleared without being saved

business_rules.name: transcript_must_not_contain_sensitive_identifiers
business_rules.description: If the transcript contains what looks like an Aadhaar number or bank account number, that part is removed before it is stored or used.
triggers: Transcript is produced from speech
Student edits the transcript to include a long number
side_effects: Matching 12-digit or account-like number sequences are replaced with a placeholder in Profile.situation_text
The student sees a notice that sensitive numbers are not needed and were removed
error_handling: If a number is only partly removed, the student is asked to rephrase the sentence without ID or account numbers
If the removal changes the meaning, the student is asked to retype the situation in their own words

business_rules.name: microphone_permission_denied_falls_back_to_typing
business_rules.description: If the student refuses microphone access, the typed input remains available and nothing is recorded.
triggers: Browser asks for microphone permission and the student declines
Device has no microphone
side_effects: The microphone button is shown as unavailable and the student is guided to the text field
Profile.input_method remains 'text'
error_handling: A plain message explains that the microphone is off and how to turn it on in browser settings, while typing still works

validation_rules.description: The situation text must not be empty after transcription or typing before the student can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Please tell us a little about your situation, by speaking or typing.

validation_rules.description: The situation text is between 5 and 500 characters, so a short spoken sentence is accepted but long transcripts are trimmed.
validation_rules.error_message: Please keep your message under 500 characters. Try a short sentence about your family and studies.

validation_rules.description: The situation text must not contain 12-digit numbers or long digit sequences that look like Aadhaar or bank account numbers.
validation_rules.error_message: Please do not include ID or bank numbers. You do not need them here.

validation_rules.description: A language must be selected from English or the supported regional language before voice input starts.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a language before you start speaking.

validation_rules.description: The student must confirm the transcript is correct before continuing to profile extraction.
validation_rules.error_message: Please check your words above and tap 'This is correct' to continue.

steps.description: The recorded audio is sent to OpenAI for transcription and the text is returned to the intake screen.

business_rules.name: audio_is_transcribed_and_discarded
business_rules.description: A recorded voice message is sent to OpenAI for transcription, the text is returned to the intake screen, and the audio is not stored by HaqPath.
triggers: Person taps stop after recording a short spoken description of their situation on the intake screen
side_effects: The transcribed text is shown in the intake screen's text box
The audio recording is deleted from the device and server once transcription returns or fails
No audio is written to the Profile record
error_handling: If OpenAI transcription fails or times out, the screen tells the person the voice message could not be read and offers the typed-input option instead
If the recording was too quiet or empty, the transcript is blank and the person is asked to record again or type

business_rules.name: transcript_requires_person_confirmation_before_profile_update
business_rules.description: The returned transcript is shown to the person for review and editing, and it is saved to Profile.intake_text only after they confirm it.
triggers: Transcription returns text to the intake screen
Person taps Use this text or edits the text and taps Continue
side_effects: Profile.intake_text is set to the confirmed text
The follow-up question flow starts using the confirmed text to extract profile details
error_handling: If the person taps Re-record, the previous transcript is discarded and Profile.intake_text is not changed
If the person closes the screen without confirming, no text is saved to Profile

business_rules.name: transcription_language_follows_selected_language
business_rules.description: The transcription request uses the language the person selected on the welcome screen, either English or the regional language.
triggers: Person records voice on the intake screen after choosing a language on the welcome screen
side_effects: The OpenAI transcription request includes the language hint for the selected language
The returned transcript is displayed in the language the person spoke
error_handling: If Profile.preferred_language is missing, the transcription uses automatic language detection and the screen asks the person to confirm the language
If the detected language differs from the selected one, the person sees a prompt to switch the language or keep the current choice

business_rules.name: transcript_must_not_be_used_to_collect_sensitive_identity_data
business_rules.description: If a transcript contains what looks like an Aadhaar number, bank account number, or similar identity number, the text is not saved and the person is asked to remove it.
triggers: Transcription returns text containing a long run of digits or an ID-like pattern
side_effects: The screen highlights the ID-like part of the text and asks the person to delete it before continuing
Profile.intake_text is not set until the sensitive-looking text is removed
error_handling: If the person insists on keeping the text, the app still does not save the number and proceeds with the rest of the text
The person sees a plain-language reminder that HaqPath does not need ID numbers or bank details

business_rules.name: voice_input_falls_back_to_typing
business_rules.description: Voice input is optional, so when recording or transcription is unavailable the person can continue by typing their situation.
triggers: Microphone permission is denied
Transcription fails or the device is offline
Person chooses Type instead of Speak
side_effects: The intake screen switches to a typed text box with the same Continue action
Profile.intake_text is set from the typed text once the person confirms
error_handling: If microphone access is denied, the screen explains how to allow it in simple language and keeps the typed option visible
If the device is offline and the demo is running, the typed or preloaded persona text is used instead

validation_rules.description: A recording must be present before transcription is requested.
validation_rules.error_message: We did not hear anything. Please record again or type your message.

validation_rules.description: The recording must be in an audio format the transcription service accepts, such as webm, mp4, m4a, mp3, or wav.
validation_rules.error_message: This recording type is not supported. Please try recording again.

validation_rules.description: The recording must be between 1 second and 60 seconds long and under 10 MB, since the intake asks for one short sentence.
validation_rules.error_message: Please keep your message under 60 seconds. Try a short sentence.

validation_rules.description: The language used for transcription must be either English or the regional language.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose English or your language.

validation_rules.description: The confirmed transcript or typed text must contain at least one meaningful word before it is saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please tell us a little about your situation, for example: My daughter is in Class 11.

validation_rules.description: The confirmed text must be between 3 and 500 characters, which keeps the intake to one short sentence or a short paragraph.
validation_rules.error_message: Please keep your message under 500 characters. Shorter is fine.

validation_rules.description: The confirmed text must not contain a run of 9 or more digits or a 12-digit ID-like number, because these may be Aadhaar or bank numbers.
validation_rules.error_message: Please remove the number. HaqPath does not need ID or bank numbers.

steps.description: The scheme explanation is sent to OpenAI for simple-language rewriting only, while the eligibility reasons stay as stored rule text.

business_rules.name: only_scheme_explanation_text_is_sent_for_rewriting
business_rules.description: The simplification request sends only the scheme's stored plain-language explanation and short description to OpenAI, and never the eligibility decision, the eligibility rule text, or the household profile.
triggers: A person opens a scheme detail screen and chooses simpler wording
The results screen requests simplified scheme summaries in the selected language
side_effects: OpenAI returns a simpler rewrite of the scheme explanation text only
The rewritten text is stored as the simplified version of Scheme.plain_language_explanation for the chosen language
error_handling: If the request payload contains any field other than the scheme explanation text, the request is refused and nothing is sent to OpenAI
If the scheme has no explanation text, no rewrite is requested and the screen shows the scheme's short description

business_rules.name: eligibility_reasons_always_use_stored_rule_text
business_rules.description: The reasons shown in EligibilityResult (why it may fit, what still needs verification, why it may not fit) are taken verbatim from EligibilityRule reason text and are never produced or changed by OpenAI.
triggers: Eligibility matching completes and results are displayed
A person opens a scheme detail screen to read why it matched
side_effects: The reason text shown to the person is identical to the stored EligibilityRule.reason_text
No AI-generated wording is written into EligibilityResult
error_handling: If an EligibilityRule has no reason text, the result is flagged for content review and the rule's identifier is shown instead of invented text
If OpenAI is unavailable, the stored reason text is shown unchanged

business_rules.name: rewritten_text_must_pass_trust_language_check
business_rules.description: A rewritten explanation is accepted only if it contains no guaranteed-eligibility wording (such as 'approved' or 'guaranteed'); otherwise the stored original text is used.
triggers: OpenAI returns a rewritten scheme explanation
side_effects: The rewrite is saved as the simplified explanation only if it passes the check
A failed rewrite is discarded and the original explanation remains in use
error_handling: If the rewrite contains forbidden guaranteed-eligibility words, the rewrite is discarded and the stored original text is shown
The discarded rewrite is logged for review without storing any personal data

business_rules.name: rewrite_must_preserve_scheme_facts
business_rules.description: A rewritten explanation must not change scheme facts: the official link, the verification date, the deadline, and the benefit amount must match the stored Scheme values exactly.
triggers: OpenAI returns a rewritten scheme explanation
side_effects: The simplified text is saved only when the facts it contains match the stored Scheme fields
Scheme.official_url and Scheme.last_verified_at remain displayed from the stored record, not from the rewrite
error_handling: If the rewrite contains a deadline or amount that differs from the stored value, the rewrite is discarded and the original text is shown
If the rewrite drops or alters the official link, the rewrite is discarded

business_rules.name: simplified_explanation_cached_per_scheme_and_language
business_rules.description: Each accepted simplified explanation is cached per scheme and language so that the same rewrite is not requested from OpenAI repeatedly, and the cache is cleared when the scheme's stored explanation changes.
triggers: A simplified explanation is requested for a scheme in a language that already has an accepted rewrite
A scheme's plain_language_explanation is edited in the stored scheme data
side_effects: The cached rewrite is served from Upstash instead of a new OpenAI call
The cached rewrite for that scheme is removed when the stored explanation changes
error_handling: If the cache is unavailable, the rewrite is requested again and the stored original text is shown while waiting
If a cached rewrite no longer matches the stored explanation, it is not served

business_rules.name: fallback_to_stored_explanation_on_ai_failure
business_rules.description: If OpenAI is unreachable or times out, the scheme detail screen shows the stored plain-language explanation so the demo and the person's journey are never blocked.
triggers: The OpenAI request fails, times out, or returns an unusable response
side_effects: The stored Scheme.plain_language_explanation is displayed in place of a simplified version
No simplified text is saved for that request
error_handling: A timeout returns the stored explanation within the normal screen load time
A malformed response is discarded and the stored explanation is used

name: Read How HaqPath Decides and What It Does Not Collect
description: A student reads how eligibility is decided and what data HaqPath does not collect before trusting the results.

steps.description: The student taps the trust statement link on the welcome screen.

business_rules.name: trust_statement_opens_without_data_collection
business_rules.description: Tapping the trust statement on the welcome screen opens the 'How HaqPath Decides and What It Does Not Collect' screen without creating, reading, or changing any stored record and without requiring sign-in or a profile.
triggers: The student taps the trust statement link on the welcome screen
side_effects: The 'How HaqPath decides' screen is shown with its explanation of rule-based matching, the 'Last verified' concept, the official-source policy, and the disclaimer 'HaqPath provides guidance based on published rules. Final eligibility is decided by the relevant authority.'
No Profile, EligibilityResult, Checklist, or ChecklistItem record is created or changed
error_handling: If the explanation content cannot be fetched because the network is down, the screen shows the bundled copy of the same text so the student still sees the disclaimer and what HaqPath does not collect
If the student has no internet access, the screen still opens fully from bundled content with no error shown

business_rules.name: trust_disclaimer_text_is_fixed_and_identical_everywhere
business_rules.description: The disclaimer 'HaqPath provides guidance based on published rules. Final eligibility is decided by the relevant authority.' appears verbatim on this screen and is never replaced by AI-generated wording.
triggers: The 'How HaqPath decides' screen is rendered
side_effects: The disclaimer is displayed as fixed text on the screen
Any translated version shown in the regional-language toggle keeps the same meaning and is supplied from bundled content, not generated at runtime
error_handling: If a regional-language translation of the disclaimer is missing, the English disclaimer is shown instead of an unreviewed machine translation

steps.description: The privacy screen explains that rules are published, deterministic, editable, and that Aadhaar, bank details, and document scans are never collected.

business_rules.name: eligibility_rules_must_be_published_to_users
business_rules.description: Every EligibilityRule that feeds a scheme's result is shown to the user in plain language, so a person can read the exact conditions behind any match or non-match.
triggers: User opens the 'How HaqPath decides' screen
User opens a scheme detail screen and asks to see the rule behind a result
side_effects: The privacy screen lists each published condition for every scheme, such as state, class level, institution type, and income ceiling
Each scheme shows its 'Last verified on' date next to the published conditions
No condition is shown as hidden or AI-generated
error_handling: If a scheme has no published rules, the screen states that the rules are being updated and does not show that scheme as a match
If rule data cannot be loaded, the screen shows the last successfully loaded published rules with their verification date and a notice that they may be out of date
If a rule has a missing field, that condition is shown as 'not published yet' rather than being silently omitted

business_rules.name: eligibility_must_be_deterministic_from_stored_rules
business_rules.description: The same Profile answers and the same EligibilityRule set always produce the same EligibilityResult, with no AI model deciding eligibility.
triggers: User completes or changes an answer in the intake or follow-up flow
A rule is edited by the maintainer and the results are recalculated
User opens the 'How HaqPath decides' screen to confirm the method
side_effects: EligibilityResult.match_status is set from comparing Profile answers against each EligibilityRule condition
EligibilityResult.reasons records which condition passed, failed, or still needs confirmation
AI is used only to understand the user's words and rewrite text, never to set match_status
error_handling: If a Profile answer needed by a rule is missing, the result is set to 'May qualify' with that condition listed under 'What we still need to verify'
If two rules conflict or a rule is malformed, the scheme is excluded from results and the fault is logged for the maintainer
If AI transcription or translation fails, the user is asked to retype the answer and no eligibility is computed from the failed input

business_rules.name: eligibility_rules_must_be_editable_data_not_code
business_rules.description: EligibilityRule records are stored as editable data separate from application code, so a maintainer can change a published condition without changing the product logic.
triggers: Maintainer updates an EligibilityRule after an official source changes
Maintainer adds or removes a condition on a scheme
side_effects: Updated EligibilityRule values are used the next time results are computed
Scheme.last_verified_at is set to the date the maintainer confirmed the change against the official source
The 'How HaqPath decides' screen shows the updated conditions and verification date
error_handling: If an edited rule uses an unknown condition type, the save is rejected and the previous rule stays in effect
If an edit removes all conditions for a scheme, the scheme is hidden from results until a valid rule is saved

business_rules.name: sensitive_identity_data_must_never_be_collected
business_rules.description: The product never asks for or stores Aadhaar numbers, bank account details, or scans of documents, and no Profile field may hold them.
triggers: User opens the privacy screen
Any intake or follow-up question is prepared for display
A Profile is created or updated from a user message
side_effects: Profile stores only the eligibility answers needed to evaluate EligibilityRule conditions
Any sensitive-looking number or document mention in a user message is not saved to Profile and the user is told not to share it
The privacy screen states that Aadhaar, bank details, and document scans are never collected
error_handling: If a user types an Aadhaar-like number or bank account number, the value is discarded before storage and the user sees a message asking them not to share it
If a user uploads or pastes a document image, it is not stored and the user is told that documents are only listed, not uploaded

name: Judge Demo Mode With Preloaded Personas
description: A judge switches on demo mode, picks a fictional persona such as Lakshmi's daughter, and runs the full journey offline using preloaded data.

steps.description: The judge opens demo mode, which is hidden from regular users, and chooses a fictional persona.

business_rules.name: demo_mode_hidden_from_regular_users
business_rules.description: The demo mode entry point is available only to judges and is not shown in the normal user journey (welcome → intake → results).
triggers: A judge opens the hidden demo mode entry point
A regular user navigates the app without the demo switch being enabled
side_effects: The demo mode page opens only for judge sessions
Regular users see no demo mode option and cannot reach the persona list
The active Profile is marked as a demo profile when a persona is chosen
error_handling: A regular user who reaches the demo mode URL directly is sent back to the welcome screen with no mention of demo personas
If the demo switch is disabled, the persona list is not loaded and no demo Profile is created

business_rules.name: demo_persona_must_be_fictional_and_preloaded
business_rules.description: Judges can only choose from a fixed set of preloaded fictional personas, such as Lakshmi's daughter in Class 11, and no real or newly typed personal details are accepted in demo mode.
triggers: A judge selects a persona card on the demo mode page
A judge attempts to create a custom persona in demo mode
side_effects: The chosen preloaded persona is stored in Upstash and loaded as the active Profile
Profile.is_demo is set to true for the session
The judge is taken to the results flow using the persona's data
error_handling: If the chosen persona key is not in the preloaded list, the selection is rejected and the judge sees the persona list again
If Upstash cannot return the preloaded personas, the demo falls back to the bundled fictional persona data so the demo still runs offline

business_rules.name: persona_profile_contains_only_allowed_eligibility_fields
business_rules.description: A demo Profile holds only the eligibility fields needed for matching (state, class level, institution type, household income band, and optional category) and never contains Aadhaar, bank, or document data.
triggers: A preloaded persona is loaded into the active Profile
The persona data is fetched from Upstash
side_effects: The Profile is populated with the persona's state, class, institution type, income, and category
Eligibility results are recalculated from the loaded Profile values
error_handling: If a persona record contains a field outside the allowed set, that field is dropped and the persona still loads
If a required eligibility field is missing from the persona, the persona is marked as incomplete and the judge is told it cannot be used in the demo

business_rules.name: demo_profile_changes_are_session_scoped
business_rules.description: Changes a judge makes to a demo Profile during the demo are kept for the current session only and reset to the original preloaded values when the demo is restarted or a new persona is chosen.
triggers: A judge changes a Profile answer while in demo mode
A judge leaves demo mode or selects a different persona
side_effects: Session edits to the demo Profile are discarded when the judge restarts the demo
The preloaded persona record in Upstash is left unchanged
EligibilityResult values are recomputed from the reset Profile
error_handling: If the session is lost mid-demo, the judge is returned to the persona picker and the Profile is reloaded from the preloaded record

validation_rules.description: A judge must choose one preloaded persona before the demo can continue.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a demo persona to continue.

validation_rules.description: The chosen persona must match one of the fixed preloaded persona keys; free-text persona names are not accepted.
validation_rules.error_message: This demo persona is not available. Please choose one from the list.

steps.description: The app loads preloaded fictional personas and their rules, falling back to bundled data if Upstash is unreachable.

business_rules.name: demo_personas_load_from_upstash_first
business_rules.description: When a judge enters demo mode, the fictional Profile records and their EligibilityRule records are read from Upstash first.
triggers: A judge switches on demo mode
The demo personas screen requests the preloaded personas
side_effects: The judge sees the preloaded fictional personas and their rules
No Profile or EligibilityRule record is changed in Upstash by loading them
error_handling: Upstash is unreachable or times out: the bundled persona and rule data is used instead, and the judge still sees the full demo
Upstash returns a record that fails the expected shape: that record is skipped and the rest still load

business_rules.name: bundled_fallback_when_upstash_unreachable
business_rules.description: If Upstash cannot be reached, the bundled Profile and EligibilityRule data is served so the demo works with no internet access.
triggers: Upstash connection fails or times out while loading demo personas
The app starts with no network connection
side_effects: The demo personas and their rules are served from bundled data
The judge sees the same personas and results as the live path, with no visible error
error_handling: Bundled data is missing or malformed: the demo shows a plain message that personas are unavailable, and the rest of the app keeps working
Upstash becomes reachable again on a later request: live data is used again

business_rules.name: only_fictional_personas_are_served
business_rules.description: Every Profile served in demo mode must be marked as fictional with Profile.is_demo set to true, and no real user Profile may appear in this route.
triggers: The demo personas route builds its response
A Profile record is read from Upstash or the bundled data
side_effects: Only Profile records flagged as demo are returned to the judge
Any Profile without the demo flag is excluded from the response
error_handling: A Profile without the demo flag is found in the Upstash data: it is excluded and the exclusion is logged
All Profile records are excluded: the bundled personas are used instead

business_rules.name: eligibility_rules_are_data_not_route_logic
business_rules.description: The EligibilityRule records are returned as stored data, and this route applies no matching logic of its own, so every rule can be read and edited as data.
triggers: The demo personas route returns EligibilityRule records alongside Profile records
side_effects: The judge's view of each rule matches the stored rule exactly
Changing an EligibilityRule record changes the demo result without a code change
error_handling: An EligibilityRule is missing a required field: that rule is excluded from the response and the omission is logged
No EligibilityRule records are available from either source: the demo shows that rules could not be loaded

business_rules.name: demo_profiles_read_only_for_judges
business_rules.description: Loading demo personas does not save any change to a Profile; edits a judge makes later stay in the session and are not written back to Upstash.
triggers: A judge changes a persona answer after the personas load
A judge reloads the demo personas
side_effects: The stored Profile records stay unchanged for the next judge
Each reload returns the original fictional persona
error_handling: A write to a demo Profile is attempted from this route: the write is refused and the stored persona stays unchanged

steps.description: The judge lands on the results screen with the persona's grouped schemes already evaluated.

business_rules.name: demo_persona_results_evaluated_before_display
business_rules.description: When a judge opens a demo persona, its Profile is evaluated against every active Scheme's EligibilityRule set before the results screen renders, so no result shows as pending or empty.
triggers: Judge selects a preloaded fictional persona in demo mode and is routed to the results screen
Judge loads the results route directly with a demo persona identifier
side_effects: One EligibilityResult is created or refreshed for each Scheme the persona is evaluated against
Evaluated results for the persona are cached in Upstash so repeat demo loads return the same outcome without re-running the evaluation
The results screen renders from the stored EligibilityResult records and does not call an AI service
error_handling: If the persona Profile is missing or incomplete, show the judge a message that this demo persona cannot be loaded and offer the list of available personas
If a Scheme has no active EligibilityRule, exclude it from grouping and log it for the data maintainer rather than showing it as eligible
If Upstash is unreachable, re-evaluate the persona in-process from bundled fictional data so the demo still works offline
If evaluation throws for one Scheme, record that Scheme as not evaluated and continue with the rest so the page still renders

business_rules.name: results_grouped_into_three_fixed_categories
business_rules.description: Every EligibilityResult is placed in exactly one of three groups in this order: likely eligible, may qualify (one or more details need confirmation), or not currently eligible.
triggers: Results screen renders for a demo persona
EligibilityResult statuses are computed for the persona
side_effects: Likely eligible group is shown first, then the may qualify group, then the not currently eligible group
A scheme with all rules matched and nothing unverified becomes likely eligible
A scheme with no failed rules but one or more unverified rules becomes may qualify
A scheme with at least one failed rule becomes not currently eligible
error_handling: If a result has no status, show it under may qualify with the note that the rules could not be fully checked, rather than dropping it
If a group is empty for a persona, show the group heading with a short plain-language line saying no schemes fall here for this profile

business_rules.name: every_result_explains_its_reasoning
business_rules.description: Each EligibilityResult shows why the scheme may fit, what still needs verification, and why it may not fit, drawn only from its stored matched, failed, and unverified rules.
triggers: A result card is rendered on the results screen
A judge expands a result to see its reasoning
side_effects: The 'Why this may fit' section lists each matched rule in plain language
The 'What we still need to verify' section lists each unverified rule and the profile detail that would settle it
The 'Why this may not fit' section lists each failed rule in a respectful sentence and does not show the raw rule expression
error_handling: If a matched, failed, or unverified rule has no plain-language reason, show the rule's name and flag it for the data maintainer instead of leaving the section blank
If a result has no failed rules, omit the 'Why this may not fit' section rather than showing an empty block

business_rules.name: result_wording_never_claims_approval
business_rules.description: Result labels and summaries use only 'Likely eligible' and 'May qualify' for positive outcomes and never use 'approved', 'guaranteed', or equivalent certainty language.
triggers: Results screen renders any status label or summary sentence
Read-aloud output is generated from the results screen
side_effects: Status badges display 'Likely eligible', 'May qualify', or 'Not currently eligible'
Summary text on each card states that the final decision is made by the relevant authority
error_handling: If any stored text contains approval or guarantee wording, replace it with the approved labels before display and flag the source record for correction

business_rules.name: results_show_source_verification_and_deadline
business_rules.description: Every result card shows the scheme's official source link, the date the scheme was last verified, and its deadline, together with the standard guidance disclaimer.
triggers: A result card is rendered
Results screen is displayed for any demo persona
side_effects: Each card links to the official source in a new tab
Each card shows 'Last verified on' with the scheme's last_verified_at date
Each card shows the deadline and a days-remaining countdown when a deadline exists
The results page displays the disclaimer that HaqPath provides guidance based on published rules and that final eligibility is decided by the relevant authority
error_handling: If a scheme has no official_url, do not show the result as likely eligible; move it to may qualify with a note that the official source must be confirmed
If last_verified_at is older than the configured freshness window, show the date with a visible 'please re-check' note
If the deadline has passed, show the scheme with a closed-deadline label rather than a countdown
